subject: [PATCH 2/3] blk-iocost: clear delay state when freeing policy data

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the blk-iocost module by clearing the delay state when freeing policy data. The issue was that the delay state was not being cleared after the policy data was removed, causing the block-cgroup to remain congested even though no further bios could arrive. This led to incorrect throttling behavior for tasks in the affected cgroups and their descendants. The patch adds a call to blkcg_clear_delay() when freeing policy data to ensure that the delay state is properly cleared.
